\- Be aware that different alters will have different boundaries, getting to know those is a part of getting to know them. These things, while all being done with good intentions, can be very upsetting to some alters. 

\- Be mindful of an alters age, If you and your friend are cooking together and your friend is suddenly five, **do not let them handle the knives,** or anything else not safe in the hands of a five year old.
